_instructions: Copy this file to reviewers/registry.json and edit it. The repo ships NO API keys and NO real adapters — each entry is just a command you point at your own vision-capable reviewer. The command reads a JSON envelope on stdin and MUST write one valid review JSON (schemas/review.schema.json) to stdout. command can be any executable: node, python3, a shell script, or curl wrapper.

doubao.notes: Example only: you write an adapter that calls your Doubao vision client and emits review JSON.

openai.notes: Example only: any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint.

human.notes: Example only: open the screenshot and wait for a human to type a review JSON.
